dictionary.enroll_hint: Speak calmly, in your normal tone, at your usual distance.

dictionary.enroll_ok: ✓ Perfect, moving to the next one.
dictionary.enroll_retry_name: I didn't hear “{{name}}”: say it again a little closer to the microphone.
dictionary.enroll_retry: I didn't hear well: repeat the sentence a little closer to the microphone.
dictionary.enroll_moving_on: That's fine: moving on, I'll keep learning while we talk.
dictionary.enroll_too_loud: ✓ Got it. The microphone is a bit loud: step back slightly.
dictionary.enroll_too_soft: ✓ Got it. I hear you softly: come a little closer.
dictionary.enroll_stopped: Test stopped: I'll keep learning your voice while we talk.
dictionary.enroll_done_voice: Perfect, {{name}}: from now on I'll also recognise your voice.
dictionary.enroll_done_trained: Perfect, {{name}}: I've learned your voice and how you say my name. I understood {{score}}% of the sentences.
dictionary.enroll_save_failed: I learned your voice, but couldn't save the dictionary: try again later.
dictionary.enroll_unavailable: Voiceprints aren't available on this system: I'll keep recognising you by your face.

dictionary.ear_err_busy: microphone in use by another program
dictionary.ear_parked: Listening handed to the visible page

dictionary.ear_need_https: This device's microphone: open Nuxiva with https:// (certificate at /nuxiva-ca.crt)
dictionary.flow_no_detail: No further detail for this step.
dictionary.flow_empty_text: Ask {{assistant}} a question from the dock: the graph builds in real time showing memory, laws, consensus verdicts, ReAct loops and returns.
dictionary.ri_loading: Reading the real behaviour from the code…
dictionary.ri_honest: Everything shown here is read live from the code that answers your questions: strategy, models, formulas and current state.
dictionary.ri_route_chat: The question goes to the fast model chain, in this order:
dictionary.ri_route_deep: The question goes to the deep model chain, in this order:
dictionary.ri_no_models: No model configured for this chain.
dictionary.ri_auto_desc: For each question it computes the complexity (words ÷ {{words}}, max 1) and checks the rules in order: the first true one wins.
dictionary.ri_words_label: Try it: words in the question
dictionary.ri_f_critic: Simulated critic (predicted impact on the user)
dictionary.ri_f_fallback: If no started model answers, it tries the reserve models one at a time. The same question is never sent twice to the same model.
dictionary.ri_limbic_desc: Emotional modulator values: only the automatic choice (Auto) and the critic use them. No real sensor changes them yet, so they stay at their starting values.
dictionary.ri_pick_sequential: one at a time, in order
dictionary.ri_pick_best: compare and keep the highest score
dictionary.ri_f_stop_sequential: Tries the models in order and stops at the first that answers.
dictionary.ri_f_stop_first: The first valid answer wins: the other models are stopped right away.
dictionary.ri_f_stop_best: After the first valid answer it waits at most {{wait}} s for the others, then picks the highest score.
